headline: Curated resources harmonize heterogeneous biomedical data for cross-study comparison
label: Curated Biomedical Knowledge Databases
summary: Integrated, standardized knowledge resources now connect biomarker, drug-response, toxicity and disease-specific evidence across studies and data types.
synthesis: The common thread is curation and integration that make heterogeneous biomedical data comparable across studies. PharmGEO standardizes 7,931 drug-response transcriptomic experiments across 1,334 drugs by reprocessing them through a single pipeline in a Shiny atlas. BiomarkerKB harmonizes biomarker data under a BEST-based model and serves a Neo4j graph of more than 200,000 associations integrated into the CFDE. IBDkb aggregates literature, trials, drugs, targets and compounds for inflammatory bowel disease, with AI-enabled search. The toxicity concordance study is less a database than an analytic resource, quantifying cross-species preclinical-clinical agreement for 7,565 small molecules and biologics via likelihood ratios, with an open web app and ToxAgents. The supplied summaries report no association-level accuracy metrics for BiomarkerKB, so the utility of its graph remains to be assessed.
